title: The Reconciliation of Layers
description: The world settles into a precarious, dynamic equilibrium. Reality is now understood as a spectrum, not a binary. The old Veil is gone, replaced by a permeable, fluctuating membrane. Societies have radically transformed: geography is semi-fluid, architecture incorporates dream-stuff, and governance requires managing both physical and psychic resources. A new understanding of Onieromancy emerges—not as manipulation, but as dialogue with a now-sentient aspect of the world.

narrative_direction: From conflict to integration and stewardship. The world has irrevocably changed, and the central question is no longer 'how do we stop this?' but 'how do we live with this, and what do we become?'
themes: the birth of a new world order
unresolved_mysteries: As the layers reconcile, are they giving birth to a new, third layer of reality?
What was the original intent behind creating the Veil in the distant past? Who or what built it?
plot_hooks: The first 'Lucid Consensus' is formed—a governing body where skilled dream-walkers directly negotiate treaties with coalesced entities of the Dreaming.
A fundamental law of the new reality is discovered: sustained collective belief in Mundus can now physically reshape the Liminal Reaches, making ideology the ultimate geopolitical force.
central_conflict: The struggle to build a sustainable, ethical civilization upon a foundation of active, conscious reality, balancing the needs of tangible Mundus and the will of expressive Oneiros.
